description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface to display log messages in a UI component. It formats log data and outputs it within a user interface element.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView used for outputting log data received via the LogNode interface, capable of formatting log entries and appending them to the displayed log.

methods.name: LogView(Context)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LogView with a given context.

methods.name: LogView(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LogView with a given context and attribute set.

methods.name: LogView(Context, AttributeSet, int)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LogView with a context, attribute set, and default style.

methods.name: println(int, String, String, Throwable)
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, converting priority codes to readable text, and appends it to the view; passes the log to the next node if available.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog(String)
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the log display.
